title: マイルCSの後に・ヘイルメリー

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Trainer, did ya see me?!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Thanks! My body's burnin' hot! These G1 races sure turn up the heat!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Good race, Taiki.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Hey, Suzuka! Same to you!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I might've won today, but you sure gave me a run for my money! Thanks a lot, Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: No… I should be the one saying thanks.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: What?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I came here to thank you.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: When we were running, your speed struck me to my core…

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: It helped me realize something.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: So… thank you.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Umm, sure…

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: If that's how ya feel, then I'm awful glad I could help!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: But I ain't goin' down next time either! Where're ya thinkin' of heading next?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Actually… I'm going to Hong Kong. There's something I don't want to lose sight of.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Are you for real?! That's some grit you've got! You're somethin' else, Suzuka!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: That means I won't see you for a while. What are your plans, Taiki?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Hm… I'm gonna keep running in more and more races. I wanna see how fast I can go!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Next up is the Yasuda Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With that, the Mile Championship draws to a close.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: The very limits of speed…

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I'll get there one day, no matter what!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I just got off the phone with my folks! They were thrilled to pieces at the good news!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: But the real surprise is still to come!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: When I become Umamusume of the Year, they'll be in for even more of a treat!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: How 'bout it, Trainer? You think I did well enough to be Umamusume of the Year?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I think she's done all she can possibly do as a sprinter.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But there's no denying that there are other Umamusume who have done exceptionally well this past year…
choice_data_list: Let's wait for the announcement in January.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Ooh, I don't think I can handle the suspense!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: But training's sure to take my mind off things! If I just keep movin', January'll be here quick as a wink!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: All right! I've got more running to do till I'm Umamusume of the Year!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We continue training diligently for the upcoming Yasuda Kinen, awaiting the announcement of the next Umamusume of the Year…
